But census of every `should_take_extra_turn` listener in the sim finds exactly one (`relics/paels_eye.py`), and its own trigger condition (`not any cards played this turn`) is structurally incompatible with `_plays_used` having anything nonzero to lose — so today's one live extra-turn source can never actually observe the reset. DORMANT, not previously determined either way. A faithful fix needs `history.py` (a `BlockGainedEntry` type) + `cmds.py` (`BlockCmd` wiring), both outside this lane's footprint — noted, not attempted, since nothing currently depends on it.
